# Oracle parser/compiler acceptance-and-rejection probes (generated by
# gen-parser-behaviors.exs). '=>' lines show event summaries (voice,
# step, grid, vel, performed_s) or the raised message. Error TEXTS are
# informative, not normative; which inputs fail, and the line cited,
# are normative. See rust-port-spec.md.

## tempo after a voice still sets global tempo (events at 120bpm spacing? no — 60bpm)
  | tempo 120
  | seed 1
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x.x.
  | tempo 60
  => OK, 8 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=2 grid=1/2 vel=100 performed_s=0.5
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.0
    k step=6 grid=3/2 vel=100 performed_s=1.5
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=2.0
    k step=10 grid=5/2 vel=100 performed_s=2.5
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=3.0
    k step=14 grid=7/2 vel=100 performed_s=3.5

## 'swing' after the first voice is a VOICE swing on the most recent voice (hits on odd 16ths delayed)
  | tempo 120
  | seed 1
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate xx..
  | swing 75% 1/16
  => OK, 8 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=1 grid=1/4 vel=100 performed_s=0.1875
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.5
    k step=5 grid=5/4 vel=100 performed_s=0.6875
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.0
    k step=9 grid=9/4 vel=100 performed_s=1.1875
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.5
    k step=13 grid=13/4 vel=100 performed_s=1.6875

## global swing must appear before any voice: same score with swing first (compare swing_ms)
  | tempo 120
  | seed 1
  | swing 75% 1/16
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate xx..
  => OK, 8 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=1 grid=1/4 vel=100 performed_s=0.1875
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.5
    k step=5 grid=5/4 vel=100 performed_s=0.6875
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.0
    k step=9 grid=9/4 vel=100 performed_s=1.1875
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.5
    k step=13 grid=13/4 vel=100 performed_s=1.6875

## repeated lane line: last one wins
  | seed 1
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate xxxx
  |   gate x...
  => OK, 4 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.5
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.0
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.5

## duplicate voice names are accepted (PRNG keys collide)
  | seed 1
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  |   hum 3
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  |   hum 3
  => OK, 8 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.001871
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.001871
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.500726
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.500726
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.002989
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.002989
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.502208
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.502208

## voice with neither sample= nor synth=
  | voice k
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: voice needs sample= or synth=

## voice with both sample= and synth=: sample wins (kind is the sample)
  | voice k sample=kick synth=pluck
  |   gate x...
  => OK, 4 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.5
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.0
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.5

## unknown voice option
  | voice k sample=kick loud
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: unknown voice option 'loud'

## unknown sample name
  | voice k sample=tom
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: unknown voice option 'sample=tom'

## unknown synth name
  | voice k synth=saw
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: unknown voice option 'synth=saw'

## lane keyword before any voice
  | vel [100]
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: 'vel' before any voice (or unknown directive)

## unknown top-level keyword
  | bogus 1
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: 'bogus' before any voice (or unknown directive)

## gate with invalid char
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x.q.
  => RAISES: score error, line 2: gate char 'q' (use x X .)

## empty gate
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate
  => RAISES: score error, line 2: empty gate

## missing gate (compile-time raise, no line number)
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   vel [100]
  => RAISES: voice k has no gate

## clock does not divide pattern (3/16-note steps into 4 beats)
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   clock 3/16
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: voice k: clock does not divide pattern

## clock 1/12 divides (triplet 16ths): 12 steps per bar
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   clock 1/12
  |   gate x...........
  => OK, 1 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0

## zero clock
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   clock 0/4
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: no function clause matching in BC.R.new/2

## swing below range
  | swing 49.9% 1/16
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: swing 49.9 out of range 50..80

## swing above range
  | swing 80.1% 1/16
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: swing 80.1 out of range 50..80

## swing at bounds 50 and 80 accepted
  | swing 50% 1/16
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  |   swing 80% 1/16
  => OK, 4 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.5
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.0
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.5

## 'swing off' as a global (before voices) is a parse error (only voices can opt out)
  | swing off
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: score error, line 1: bad number 'off'

## swing without %: the sign is optional in the syntax ('swing 58 1/16' parses)
  | swing 58 1/16
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  => OK, 4 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.5
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.0
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=1.5

## lane without brackets
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  |   vel 100
  => RAISES: score error, line 3: lane must be [v1 v2 ...] (optionally div=1/8)

## empty lane
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  |   vel []
  => RAISES: score error, line 3: empty lane

## lane div= garbage
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  |   vel [100] div=fast
  => RAISES: score error, line 3: bad note fraction 'fast' (want e.g. 1/16)

## bad note name
  | voice b synth=pluck
  |   gate x...
  |   pitch [h1]
  => RAISES: score error, line 3: bad note 'h1' (want e.g. e1, f#2, bb0)

## note octave out of single-digit (e10)
  | voice b synth=pluck
  |   gate x...
  |   pitch [e10]
  => RAISES: score error, line 3: bad note 'e10' (want e.g. e1, f#2, bb0)

  | tempo 1e2

## tempo 0: division by zero at compile
  | tempo 0
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  => RAISES: bad argument in arithmetic expression

## negative tempo: accepted, negative seconds clamp to 0
  | tempo -120
  | seed 1
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  => OK, 4 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=100 performed_s=0.0

## bars 0: the 0..-1 range pathology emits phantom steps 0 and -1 (gate indexed from the END)
  | seed 1
  | bars 0
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate ...x
  => OK, 1 events
    k step=-1 grid=-1/4 vel=100 performed_s=0.0

## negative vel parses; crashes only at render (pow of negative) — events fine
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x...
  |   vel [-50]
  => OK, 4 events
    k step=0 grid=0/1 vel=-50 performed_s=0.0
    k step=4 grid=1/1 vel=-50 performed_s=0.5
    k step=8 grid=2/1 vel=-50 performed_s=1.0
    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=-50 performed_s=1.5

  |   vel [200]

    k step=12 grid=3/1 vel=200 performed_s=1.5

## empty score compiles to zero events
  | tempo 100
  => OK, 0 events

## comment lines and blank lines ignored; inline '#' is NOT a comment (gate char error)
  | # comment
  | 
  | voice k sample=kick
  |   gate x... # nope
  => RAISES: score error, line 4: gate char '#' (use x X .)
